title: hybrid.rs: MeshPrefix::contains panics if prefix_len > 128
description: Line 135 computes `full_bytes = (prefix_len / 8) as usize`. If prefix_len > 128 (e.g., 200), full_bytes = 25, and line 139's slice `addr[..full_bytes]` panics on a 16-byte array. No validation on prefix_len. Callers of add_mesh_prefix can trigger this panic with invalid input.
